label: Feed
notes: what has been posted, with the camera as the page directly above the newest post. The `make` column that held the camera is gone. TAB_HOME — where the app opens.

label: Spotlight
notes: what the business has put in the window — one list, the same on every phone, and only an admin can change it. RIGHT OF FEED since 21 Oct (docs/history/392): the business's window sits with the other things you read and scroll.

label: Reels
notes: one clip per page, opening on the first reel; before it, one swipe back, the Videos and One more thing widgets and an admin's "+ Add a reel" (docs/history/414).

label: Tools
notes: the widgets. LEFT OF FIND since 25 Oct (Find 2 keeps the right) (docs/history/444): one swipe from a question to the whiteboard and back.

label: Find 2
notes: the owner's "finder 2" — "an identical second finder" (12 Oct): the same funnel over the same list as Find, with its own search, chips, page and kept place, so a student can keep a chapter up here while answering questions on Find. It held only the resources from 10 to 12 Oct (docs/history/329, reversed in 347). RIGHT OF FIND, which is where it was asked for.

label: Saved
notes: what you starred — widgets first, then anything else.

label: Progress
notes: a student's own record — what they have answered, what they got right, what to work on next. NOT BUILT YET: for a student (and an admin) its one card is Your journey, an outline with the countdown to their exam dates, moved here off Settings on 12 Oct; for anybody else one card saying it is not built. Nothing on either to press. RIGHT OF SAVED since 21 Oct (docs/history/392), with the other learning columns — moving it is this row's sort_order.

label: Book
notes: the form and the receipts. The basket is on the Shop column.

label: Shop
notes: the shop: the basket on top, then the things for sale grouped by kind. RIGHT OF BOOKING, the other column you pay on. Find no longer has a Shop door.

label: Student
notes: your account, and a page per person.

label: Tutor
notes: what a tutor (Staff) has: the Staff hub, the terms warning, your profile link and the teaching settings (rate, qualifications, where you teach). Shown to everybody signed in; below Staff it says it is not for your account and offers Apply to teach (docs/history/444).

label: Parent
notes: what a parent or payer has: their children's cards and Manage your child. Shown to everybody signed in; a student sees the title and "a parent links you from theirs". A column per rank, right of You (docs/history/444). Settings was folded into You.

label: Business
notes: what only an admin has: profit, setup, applications, staff, reports, imports, the business records, the build stamps, + Add a person and everybody's cards. FOR AN ADMIN ONLY: for anybody else the column is not there at all (columnsFor_ in shell.js). Business, the admin's column of the four per account (docs/history/444).
